text_block_list.text:
The morning of the Derby.
—Tokyo Racecourse, home stretch: 525.9m.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The wind... is blowing right through...
There is nothing in my way...

Standing on opposite ends were
Mejiro Ryan and Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's so loooong... There's no way I can maintain the lead down a straight like this~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“Are you sure we really can't? It's a once-in-a-lifetime chance,
even if we make every possible preparation...?”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That・part... we won't know until we try, right? In that case...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do it!
She's definitely gonna come after me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—It's not enough.
Even with 525 meters, it's still not enough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines will run away with the lead. Unless I chase her down with an even greater resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It might be impossible. I might not make it in
time. Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to take them back! Everything
I lost because of my lack of confidence!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If my talent is the real deal, I'm sure I can catch up.
To Ines!"

I stand beside Mejiro Ryan as she gazes at the distant figures.
Our Derby is about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I will hold the lead all the way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely catch up to you!!
